newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AgriBioTech started as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AgriBioTech started as strong buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she started coverage of AgriBioTech Inc with a strong buy rating.

-- In a report issued Thursday, Wittenburg said AgriBioTech is leading the consolidation of the forage and turf seed industries, which she said should ultimately result in significantly higher gross and operating margins for the company.

-- "We estimate that AgriBioTech will be profitable, on a full-year basis, starting in fiscal 1998 as the company benefits from consolidation economies of scale and other synergies," she wrote in a report.
-- Wittenburg estimates fiscal 1998 earnings at $0.17 a share, compared with an estimated fiscal 1997 loss of $0.13.
